decisions.reason: Upgrading the MeetAlfred subscription does not alter the requirement to preserve the existing integration and ongoing campaign.
The Pro-plan decision configures MeetAlfred but does not change the deferred synchronization method or lifecycle; any enablement would be implementation status rather than a requirement modification.
The MeetAlfred plan upgrade neither changes the separately defined Zapier configuration nor resumes its deferred lifecycle.
The subscription decision does not change the email campaign's channel, automation mode, platform, or deferred lifecycle.
The MeetAlfred plan upgrade does not modify the required LinkedIn campaign behavior or its current active lifecycle.
The plan upgrade does not change the specified silent-lead workflow, cleanup rule, or deferred lifecycle.
The source changes the MeetAlfred subscription, not the separate HubSpot Starter subscription.
The MeetAlfred Pro upgrade does not resolve the separate Sales Navigator Advanced versus Advance Plus conflict or resume the direct LinkedIn-to-HubSpot integration.
MeetAlfred subscription configuration does not alter the requirement to create a campaign domain.
The plan upgrade does not modify the minimal-integration policy, one-click export behavior, or downstream transfer flow.
The MeetAlfred subscription decision does not change any HubSpot lead-management capability.
MeetAlfred subscription configuration does not alter the independent domain warm-up obligation.
